learning_outcomes.text: To make the students familiar with major theories and methods of mind/brain research.

syllabus_topics: The human mind and brain from the perspective of neuroscience, computer science, psychology, and philosophy
Neuroscience and behavioral research methods for consciousness
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment includes presence (30%), presentation (40%), and bonus assignments (30%). The indicative assessment scale is A for 90%, B for 80%, C for 70%, D for 60%, and E for 50%. The assessment scale for preliminary/final is 100/0.
bibliography: S. Blackmore, E.T. Troscianko: Consciousnes. An Introduction. Routledge, third edition 2018.
M.S. Gazzaniga, R.B. Ivry, G.R. Mangun: Cognitive Neuroscience. The Biology of the Mind. W.W. Norton & company, fifth edition 2019.
J. Friedenberg, G. Silverman: Cognitive Science. An Introduction to the Study of Mind. Sage
T. Metzinger: The Ego Tunnel. The Science of the Mind and the Myth of the self. Basic Books
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
